Admin CRUD buttons (Add New, Edit, Delet.description: Admin CRUD buttons (Add New, Edit, Delete) should be gated by spec.actions for each model. Models without a create action should hide Add New; without update, hide Edit; without delete, hide Delete. Default to read-only when actions list is empty.

Admin CRUD scaffold must gate Add/Edit/D.description: Admin CRUD scaffold must gate Add/Edit/Delete buttons based on spec actions: if no 'create' action exists for a model, hide 'Add New'; if no 'delete' action, hide Delete. Default to inferring from model's presence in spec.actions.

Admin list views generated by Claude fre.description: Admin list views generated by Claude frequently emit /admin/{model}/* links but model CRUD routes actually mount at /{model}/*: always verify that admin link URL prefix matches the actual mount path. _fix_admin_crud_link_prefix post-processor strips /admin/ prefix from model CRUD links as the safe default.

Admin settings form must render one inpu.description: Admin settings form must render one input per spec settings key. Generic scaffolded fields (business_name/support_email/phone/address) that don't match the spec's custom keys leave the founder unable to edit live site content. Group by prefix and use appropriate input type (text/textarea/file upload).

Admin settings upload fields MUST show a.description: Admin settings upload fields MUST show a thumbnail preview of the currently-saved image above the 'Choose File' button when a value is set. Preview block visibility must be conditional on the stored value at render time, not just toggled by client-side JS on file select: otherwise the founder has no visual confirmation of what's currently live.

All contact-message routes use '/message.description: All contact-message routes use '/messages' sub-path (e.g. router.get('/messages', ...) mounted at /contact-messages), making the list endpoint /contact-messages/messages instead of /contact-messages: every CRUD URL is offset by the extra '/messages' segment and will 404 from any standard link.

Avoid creating duplicate admin view path.description: Avoid creating duplicate admin view paths (views/admin-settings.ejs AND views/admin/settings.ejs). When both exist, whichever one is referenced by an admin-dashboard router handler wins and shadows the canonical template, bypassing pipeline fixes. Future: always normalize admin views to views/admin/{slug}.ejs subdirectory convention.

Color palette injection should distribut.description: Color palette injection should distribute across multiple accents: primary/secondary/accent/sun-yellow/sun-orange should each show up on pages intentionally. Everything-blue-accent loses the palette's personality.

ContactMessage routes are not protected.description: ContactMessage routes are not protected by the requireAdmin middleware mounted in server.js (they use requireRole('admin') directly which is correct), but the spec marks ContactMessage as read-only yet a POST /:id/delete route is implemented: this is a minor spec violation but acceptable; more critically, no views/contact-messages/index.ejs or views/contact-messages/detail.ejs files were provided to confirm these views exist.

Destructive actions (Delete) need a dest.description: Destructive actions (Delete) need a destructive-outline design pattern: never styled identically to primary CTA buttons. Outline + red text → filled red on hover. Trash icon prefix recommended.

Home page conditional sections: video/ga.description: Home page conditional sections: video/gallery/featured-event blocks must render nothing (not an empty iframe placeholder) when the underlying data is empty. Wrap in <% if (items && items.length) { %> blocks or skip via controller-level guard.

Iframe post-processors must filter by EJ.description: Iframe post-processors must filter by EJS variable name pattern: rewriting only iframes whose src uses a recognized video var (embed_url, youtube_url, yt_*). Generic src variable rewrites break non-YouTube embeds (Posh, Vimeo, Stripe checkout, etc.).

No EJS views exist for notes (e.g. views.description: No EJS views exist for notes (e.g. views/notes/index.ejs, views/notes/new.ejs, views/notes/detail.ejs, views/notes/edit.ejs), so the GET /notes page required by the spec cannot render.

No dedicated route handler for GET /vide.description: No dedicated route handler for GET /videos is visible: the videosRouter is mounted at '/videos' but its implementation is not provided; if it lacks a GET '/' handler the public videos page will fail.

No route handler or router is mounted fo.description: No route handler or router is mounted for GET / (home page); there is no publicRouter content shown that confirms it handles '/', and no views/index.ejs was provided, meaning the home page will 404.

Notes reference book_ids 4 through 13 (e.description: Notes reference book_ids 4 through 13 (e.g., book_id=4 for Piranesi, book_id=5 for The Vanishing Half, etc.) but those books are never inserted due to the broken INSERT block, so those note inserts will either fail or silently produce orphaned/missing data depending on FK settings.

On dark-primary apps (primary lum < 0.15.description: On dark-primary apps (primary lum < 0.15), the admin settings page MUST use the same dark slate surface treatment as the rest of the app. White cards on a dark page is a visual jarring regression; see _fix_admin_dark_stat_cards() for pattern.

The events route file (routes/<SLUG>.js).description: The events route file (routes/events.js) was not provided; cannot verify GET /events page handler or full CRUD (list, create, read, update, delete) for the Event model.

The gallery route file (routes/<SLUG>.js.description: The gallery route file (routes/gallery.js) was not provided; cannot verify GET /gallery page handler exists.

The multi-row INSERT for books 4\u201313.description: The multi-row INSERT for books 4–13 (Piranesi through Lessons in Chemistry) is commented out with '-- SKIPPED (unbalanced quotes)' and the remaining SQL fragment is malformed, meaning only 3 books are actually inserted and all notes referencing book_id 4–13 will fail with foreign key violations or return no data.

The notes router has no GET /notes (list.description: The notes router has no GET /notes (list), GET /notes/new, POST /notes, GET /notes/:id, GET /notes/:id/edit, POST /notes/:id/update, or POST /notes/:id/delete routes: full CRUD for the Note model is entirely missing.

The photos route file (routes/<SLUG>.js).description: The photos route file (routes/photos.js) was not provided; cannot verify full CRUD for the Photo model.

The public contact form POST (spec requi.description: The public contact form POST (spec requires a public POST /contact for creating a ContactMessage without auth) does not exist: all POST/create routes require requireAuth + requireRole('admin'), so visitors cannot submit a contact message.

The validateCsrfToken function is define.description: The validateCsrfToken function is defined AFTER module.exports = { ... }, so it is not included in the exported object, causing any route file that destructures validateCsrfToken from this module to receive undefined and crash at runtime.

The videos route file (routes/<SLUG>.js).description: The videos route file (routes/videos.js) was not provided; cannot verify GET /videos page handler or full CRUD for the Video model.

There is no route handler or view provid.description: There is no route handler or view provided for GET /contact (the public contact page spec requirement): the contact-messages router is mounted at /contact but its only GET handler is '/messages' (resolving to /contact/messages), so GET /contact returns 404.

Timestamp display across views must go t.description: Timestamp display across views must go through a single app.locals.formatEventTime helper that applies timeZone option explicitly (from site_settings.site_timezone or hardcoded 'America/Chicago' for MW). Never rely on Node's default TZ in Node pg driver behavior.

Timestamps from timestamp-without-time-z.description: Timestamps from timestamp-without-time-zone columns must be converted through a single site-timezone helper on all views. Mixed UTC-labeled-as-local and properly-converted displays confuse users and cause off-by-5-hour bugs.

When a spec defines no signup/register r.description: When a spec defines no signup/register role or route, the login view's 'Register here' link must be stripped. Check whether routes/*.js registers a /signup|/register|/sign-up handler; if not, remove the dead link block.

`getValidateCsrf()` is called in POST /l.description: `getValidateCsrf()` is called in POST /login, POST /register, POST /logout, and other auth handlers but is never defined, causing a ReferenceError crash on all auth form submissions.
`getValidateCsrf()` is called in POST /login, POST /register, POST /logout, and other auth routes but is never defined or imported, crashing all authentication POST flows.

`getValidateCsrf()` is called in POST ro.description: `getValidateCsrf()` is called in POST route handlers (e.g. POST /, POST /:id/update, POST /:id/delete) but this function is never defined anywhere, causing a ReferenceError crash on every book mutation.

`getValidateCsrf()` is called in POST route handlers but never defined, and the file is missing its closing brace and `module.exports`, meaning the notes router will fail to load entirely and crash the server on startup.

`getValidateCsrf()` is called in every P.description: `getValidateCsrf()` is called in every POST handler but is never defined or imported, causing a ReferenceError crash on all book create/update/delete operations.
`getValidateCsrf()` is called in every POST handler but is never defined or imported, causing a ReferenceError crash on all note create/update/delete operations.
